cues.en: And in this video, we will start by just creating a brand new project for Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 這段影片先從建立全新的 Microsoft Foundry 專案開始。

cues.en: There are multiple ways to do it.
cues.zh: 有好幾種建立方式，

cues.en: You can actually do it from ai.azure.com or you can do it from the portal itself.
cues.zh: 可以從 ai.azure.com，也可以從 Azure Portal 建立。

cues.en: I usually like to start it from the portal.
cues.zh: 我通常喜歡先從 Portal 開始。

cues.en: So I'm going to go ahead and click on resource groups and I'm going to go ahead and create a brand new resource group in here.
cues.zh: 點 Resource Groups，在這裡建立新的資源群組，

cues.en: I'm going to use my subscription that I use for everything.
cues.zh: 使用我平常的 Azure 訂閱，

cues.en: And in the resource group name, I'm going to call it for instance, Agent Framework Course.
cues.zh: 資源群組名稱例如 Agent Framework Course，

cues.en: And usually I like to do a dash RG at the end so I can remember that this is a resource group.
cues.zh: 通常我會在最後加上 -RG，方便辨識這是資源群組。

cues.en: And the region you can use, a lot of different regions.
cues.zh: 區域有很多選擇，

cues.en: I'm going to use East US 2 and I'm going to go ahead and say next.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 East US 2，再按 Next。

cues.en: And I usually also like to give it a tag just so that I can see the billing at the end of the month or the end of the quarter based on tags.
cues.zh: 我也喜歡加上標籤，讓每月或每季能按照標籤查看費用。

cues.en: So I'm going to come in here and I'll say project.
cues.zh: 例如標籤名稱填 Project，

cues.en: And in the value for it, I'll say Agent Framework Course. All right.
cues.zh: 值填 Agent Framework Course，

cues.en: That's good enough for me.
cues.zh: 這樣就可以。

cues.en: I'm going to say next.
cues.zh: 按 Next，

cues.en: I'm going to review.
cues.zh: 檢查設定，

cues.en: Everything looks good.
cues.zh: 看起來都沒問題，

cues.en: I'm going to say create.
cues.zh: 按 Create，

cues.en: And I'll end up creating a brand new resource group.
cues.zh: 就會建立新的資源群組。

cues.en: I can go to it at this point.
cues.zh: 現在可以進入它，

cues.en: And what I need to do is probably easiest way is to go to the search all the way at the top.
cues.zh: 接著最簡單的方式，應該是到最上方搜尋欄，

cues.en: I'm going to search for the word Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 搜尋 Microsoft Foundry，

cues.en: You will notice it will show up right there with the purple new icon.
cues.zh: 就會看到這個紫色的新圖示。

cues.en: And inside of the Microsoft Foundry in here, folks, I can create a resource.
cues.zh: 在 Microsoft Foundry 裡，可以建立資源，

cues.en: I can create a resource, a Foundry resource, a managed AI resource.
cues.zh: 包括 Foundry 資源和受控 AI 資源，

cues.en: I'm going to go ahead and create a Foundry resource right there.
cues.zh: 這裡選擇建立 Foundry Resource。

cues.en: And then you'll get a similar blade where you get to choose your subscription.
cues.zh: 會出現類似的設定面板，先選訂閱，

cues.en: Already I have this Agent Framework Course RG that I've already created.
cues.zh: 這裡已經有剛才建立的 Agent Framework Course RG。

cues.en: I can give it a name.
cues.zh: 接著取個名稱，

cues.en: And we'll also call it Agent Framework Course.
cues.zh: 一樣叫 Agent Framework Course，

cues.en: And the region, we'll leave it also in the same place, East US 2.
cues.zh: 區域也保持 East US 2。

cues.en: And the project name itself, I'm going to call it Agent Framework Project. All right.
cues.zh: 專案名稱則叫 Agent Framework Project，

cues.en: That's good enough for me.
cues.zh: 這樣就可以，

cues.en: I'm going to say next.
cues.zh: 按 Next。

cues.en: Then you get to choose the storage, whether you would like to get a key vault or application insight.
cues.zh: 接著可以選擇儲存設定，是否加入 Key Vault 或 Application Insights，

cues.en: We will do that, of course, during the course.
cues.zh: 課程中當然也會介紹，

cues.en: But for right now, I'm not going to even deploy any models or anything like that.
cues.zh: 但目前先不部署模型或其他設定，

cues.en: I'll do that from the inside once the resource has been created already.
cues.zh: 資源建立後，再從裡面操作。

cues.en: For the network, I'm going to keep it as public right now so we can get to it.
cues.zh: Network 先保留 Public，方便連線。

cues.en: In real life scenarios, you would like to, of course, secure this by air gapping it maybe or just having it only accessible from the inside using a jump VM or something like that.
cues.zh: 實際應用時，當然應該加強保護，例如隔離網路，或只允許從內部透過跳板 VM 等方式存取。

cues.en: Identity, I'm going to use system assigned identities for right now.
cues.zh: Identity 目前使用系統指派身分，

cues.en: For the encryption, I'm going to trust Microsoft keys to do all the managed encryption.
cues.zh: 加密則使用微軟管理的金鑰，處理受控加密。

cues.en: I'm going to say next.
cues.zh: 按 Next，

cues.en: And again, for that, let's say project.
cues.zh: 同樣加入 Project 標籤，

cues.en: And I'm going to use also the same one, Agent Framework course, so I can actually do the budgeting and the cost at the end of the month as well.
cues.zh: 值設成 Agent Framework Course，方便每月底預算和費用管理。

cues.en: Finally, I'll review everything, make sure everything looks good.
cues.zh: 最後檢查全部設定，確認沒有問題。

cues.en: Remember, this actually will end up creating two things for me, a resource for Foundry and the project itself.
cues.zh: 記得，這其實會建立兩個東西：Foundry 資源和專案本身，

cues.en: These will be two different resources.
cues.zh: 它們是兩個不同的資源。

cues.en: I'm going to say create.
cues.zh: 按 Create，

cues.en: We'll give it here a few seconds and hopefully it will come back and will tell us that everything has been created.
cues.zh: 等幾秒，希望很快就會顯示建立完成。

cues.en: And indeed, after a few seconds, everything has gone created.
cues.zh: 確實，幾秒後全部都建立好了。

cues.en: I can now go to the resource and see what the Foundry looks like.
cues.zh: 現在可以進入資源，看看 Foundry 的內容。

cues.en: If you'd like to go back to the resource group, click on the resource group here in the resource, and we will see hopefully that there is an Agent Framework course that has been created for me.
cues.zh: 如果想回到資源群組，點資源裡的 Resource Group，就會看到剛建立的 Agent Framework Course。

cues.en: Again, I can create, click on it again.
cues.zh: 也可以再點開它，

cues.en: And notice at the top that says go to the Foundry portal or the go to Foundry portal.
cues.zh: 注意上方有 Go to Foundry Portal，或另一個進入 Foundry Portal 的連結，

cues.en: So there is multiple ways.
cues.zh: 所以有不同進入方式，

cues.en: Of course, you can click on either one of them to go to the portal.
cues.zh: 點其中任一個都能開啟入口網站，

cues.en: And that will take us to the ai.azure.com to start taking a look at what got created for us to begin with. All right.
cues.zh: 會帶到 ai.azure.com，開始查看剛建立的內容。

cues.en: So as soon as you get into the Microsoft Foundry, as you can see in here, let me close this one at the top.
cues.zh: 進入 Microsoft Foundry 後，就像這裡；先把上方視窗關掉，

cues.en: So you can see on the left side, we have the overview of all your endpoints, the API keys.
cues.zh: 左邊可以查看各種端點和 API 金鑰的總覽。

cues.en: There are three different things that you can get to in here, the Microsoft Foundry, which has a very specific endpoint.
cues.zh: 這裡有三種不同的服務資訊，Microsoft Foundry 有自己的端點，

cues.en: Notice it has the services.ai.azure.com.
cues.zh: 注意它是 services.ai.azure.com，

cues.en: We're going to get definitely a good idea about this in the near future to understand how we can actually get to the models using that Microsoft Foundry endpoint.
cues.zh: 不久後會進一步介紹，如何透過這個 Microsoft Foundry 端點取得模型。

cues.en: Also, if you click on the Azure OpenAI, in case you're going to use that, it's a different endpoint, openai.azure.com.
cues.zh: 如果點 Azure OpenAI，又是不同的端點，openai.azure.com。

cues.en: Also, there is the AI services for inferencing that we can actually get to using the cognitive services of Azure AI.
cues.zh: 另外還有 AI Services 的推論端點，透過 Azure AI 的認知服務存取。

cues.en: So we're going to go through all of these things, but I just wanted to take you really quickly against everything inside of here.
cues.zh: 這些都會逐一介紹，這裡只是先快速帶大家看一遍。

cues.en: This is the old model of the Microsoft Foundry, used to be called Azure AI Foundry as well.
cues.zh: 這是舊版 Microsoft Foundry 的介面，以前也叫 Azure AI Foundry。

cues.en: If you'd like to take a look at the new look and feel, which is the future of Microsoft Foundry, you will notice there is a toggle button at the top that says New Foundry.
cues.zh: 如果想看新版外觀，也就是 Microsoft Foundry 未來的介面，上方有 New Foundry 切換開關，

cues.en: Let's click on that and see what we can see in the new way. All right.
cues.zh: 點它看看新版內容。

cues.en: You can also select a project to continue to move the new Foundry.
cues.zh: 也可以選擇要帶入新版 Foundry 的專案，

cues.en: Not only you're going to have to have a specific Microsoft Foundry, but you'll need to have a select project to start with.
cues.zh: 不只要有 Foundry 資源，也需要先選一個專案。

cues.en: In my case in here, I already created during the creation, if you remember, it's called Asian Framework Project. Okay.
cues.zh: 這裡在建立資源時已經一起建好，名稱是 Agent Framework Project，

cues.en: So we'll click on that and we say, let's go.
cues.zh: 選取後，按 Let's Go。

cues.en: So now you're going to see the brand new, I'm going to have to log in as well.
cues.zh: 現在就會看到全新的；這裡還需要登入，

cues.en: You're going to see the brand new look and feel of the Microsoft Foundry user interface.
cues.zh: 登入後會看到新版 Microsoft Foundry 使用者介面。

cues.en: We'll have the API, a key for the project itself.
cues.zh: 這裡有專案的 API 金鑰，

cues.en: We'll have the endpoint.
cues.zh: 也有端點。

cues.en: Remember, this is the one that will have the services.ai.azure.com that I showed you before.
cues.zh: 記得，這裡是剛才展示的 services.ai.azure.com，

cues.en: It will have the open AI endpoint as well in case you need it. All right.
cues.zh: 有需要時，也有 OpenAI 端點。

cues.en: Sometimes we will not allow people to come in using an API key.
cues.zh: 有時候，組織不允許使用 API 金鑰連線，

cues.en: They will have to use enter ID.
cues.zh: 必須改用 Entra ID，

cues.en: We will do that again in the future as well.
cues.zh: 這部分之後也會介紹。

cues.en: At the time of this recording, 5.4 for GPT was just released.
cues.zh: 錄製當下，GPT-5.4 才剛發布，

cues.en: So it doesn't really matter whether you see 5.5 or 5.6 in the future, it will end up being the same thing.
cues.zh: 所以未來你看到 5.5、5.6 也沒有關係，基本做法都相同。

cues.en: And then as far as how you can access all of them, of course, the later we get 5.5 and 5.6, they will keep getting more powerful in the future, I'm sure.
cues.zh: 存取方式相同，當然，之後的 5.5、5.6，我相信能力也會越來越強。

cues.en: I just wanted to remind you that Microsoft Foundry is not just about open AI.
cues.zh: 還要提醒，Microsoft Foundry 不只提供 OpenAI，

cues.en: It's not going to be only the GPTs, okay?
cues.zh: 不是只有 GPT 模型，

cues.en: There will be Entropic for the Sonnet, for Onyx, for a lot of different things.
cues.zh: 也有 Anthropic 的 Sonnet、Opus 等各種模型。

cues.en: There will be over 11,500 different models that you can actually use from Hugging Face, from Grok, from a lot of different places as well. All right.
cues.zh: 能使用超過 11,500 個不同模型，來自 Hugging Face、Grok，以及許多不同來源。

cues.en: At the top in here, you'll see we are at the home here to get the main most important pieces, which is the API key, the endpoints, and everything else.
cues.zh: 目前在 Home，可以取得最重要的 API 金鑰、端點等資訊。

cues.en: We can go to discover, and I can see all the models, for instance, if I click on models in here, there will be a significant amount.
cues.zh: 也可以到 Discover 查看模型，例如點 Models，就會有很多內容，

cues.en: You can see the ones, for instance, for a specific industry or specific collection or for fine-tuning, but you will notice there will be tons and tons of different models
cues.zh: 能依產業、集合、微調用途等分類查看。可以看到這裡有非常多不同模型，

cues.en: in here, and they keep going like this forever, probably, because like I said, there is over 11,500 of them available in here as well.
cues.zh: 一直往下還有，彷彿看不完，因為如前所述，總共有超過 11,500 個。

cues.en: Again, we're going to go into a lot deeper, of course, into the Foundry later on.
cues.zh: 之後當然會更深入介紹 Foundry。

cues.en: I just wanted to let everybody know how do we create a Microsoft Foundry project using the portal or using AIAzure.com.
cues.zh: 這裡只是先讓大家知道，如何透過 Portal 或 ai.azure.com 建立 Microsoft Foundry 專案，

cues.en: It's the same process, very, very similar process as well.
cues.zh: 流程相同，或至少非常接近。

cues.en: We can operate by using the assets, the compliance, the quota, and do some administration, so
cues.zh: 可以透過資產、合規性、配額和管理功能操作，

cues.en: I can see how much I am being charged for using GPT-5 mini versus GPT-4.1.
cues.zh: 例如查看使用 GPT-5 mini 與 GPT-4.1，分別收了多少費用。

cues.en: I want to see my applications and my marketing team versus executive team versus accounting team, how many of them are using how much tokens, and what is it costing me and my company as well.
cues.zh: 也能看不同應用程式、行銷團隊、主管團隊、會計團隊，各自用了多少 Token，替公司帶來多少成本。

cues.en: All of these things are very important for our organization to do.
cues.zh: 這些都是組織管理的重要資訊。

cues.en: Anyway, this was a very, very fast way of just going and creating a resource and just showing you how you can work with Microsoft Foundry to start with.
cues.zh: 以上用非常快速的方式，建立一個資源，並展示 Microsoft Foundry 的基本入口。

cues.en: Again, if you would like to go back and use the old Foundry, you can always click the toggle back and come back in here, and you will have everything on the left side, very
cues.zh: 如果想回到舊版 Foundry，隨時可以切回開關，再回到這裡，左側有各種功能，

cues.en: similar to what you saw in the new user interface, just different ways of presenting it, the model catalog, the playground to try it out, agents and templates and fine-tuning and everything
cues.zh: 和新版非常相似，只是呈現方式不同，包括模型目錄、測試用 Playground、代理程式、範本、微調，以及，

cues.en: else will be in here as well.
cues.zh: 其他所有功能，都能在這裡找到。
